TAP TO LISTEN sing or play one note at a time

New tuning

Each string is a note with its octave (E2, F#3, Bb1) or a frequency in Hz (82.41). Lowest string first.

Theme

Note names

Letters or solfège, for every app: TRACK, TUNE and SING.Pocket.

MIDI device

Experimental. The keys sound with a piano (SOUND turns it off, for keyboards with their own speakers). In SCALES the keys light the notes you play, PRACTICE listens to them instead of the microphone, and a chord you hold is named and shown on your instrument. ASSIGN ties pads, buttons and knobs to the scale and JAM buttons, the JAM effects, the metronome and the tempo. Chrome, Edge or Firefox; not Safari.

Audio input

--

          

          

            Plug a guitar or any instrument into a USB audio interface (or the phone's adapter) and pick it here. The tuner and the looper
            then listen to it directly, with no echo cancelling, noise reduction or gain control, instead of the microphone. GAIN lifts a quiet input (a phone
            microphone in Firefox, a guitar cable) and is kept per input. LIVE shows the level, the note
            and what the browser really gave. TESTS runs guided checks (noise, level, channels, latency) and gives a report to copy.

Browser storage: checking…

          

            The looper keeps its loops on this device by itself and brings them back when you open it. SAVE keeps a set under a
            name, OPEN replaces the loops (the ones you had are kept as “Before opening”), EXPORT makes a file you can move to
            another device.
